fact: A report presented on 20 November 2026 by RPDH with Transparency International finds that Congo has no general framework for access to information, only sectoral texts, and that only Angola in Central Africa has a general access to information law.
title: CONGO/DROIT À L’INFORMATION: LE FOSSÉ QUI MAINTIENT LA LUTTE CONTRE LA CORRUPTION À QUAI EN AFRIQUE CENTRALE
